mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_supplier_site (supplier_id,external_site_code,external_site_name,representative_site_code,representative_site_name, center_code,center_name,price_context_code,provider_attributes,provider_listed_yn,last_seen_at,user_id) VALUES (#{supplier_id},#{external_site_code},#{external_site_name},#{representative_site_code},#{representative_site_name}, #{center_code},#{center_name},#{price_context_code},#{provider_attributes},'Y',NOW(),#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE external_site_name=VALUES(external_site_name),representative_site_code=VALUES(representative_site_code), representative_site_name=VALUES(representative_site_name),center_code=VALUES(center_code),center_name=VALUES(center_name), price_context_code=VALUES(price_context_code),provider_attributes=VALUES(provider_attributes),provider_listed_yn='Y', last_seen_at=NOW(),user_id=VALUES(user_id)
mapper.select: SELECT m.supplier_site_id,m.supplier_id,s.supplier_code,s.supplier_name,m.external_site_code,m.external_site_name, m.representative_site_code,m.representative_site_name,m.center_code,m.center_name,m.use_yn,m.provider_listed_yn, m.first_seen_at,m.last_seen_at, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(ss.account_id ORDER BY ss.account_id) FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site ss WHERE ss.supplier_id=m.supplier_id AND ss.external_site_code=m.external_site_code AND ss.active_yn='Y') assigned_account_ids FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_site m JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=m.supplier_id WHERE 1=1 AND s.supplier_code=#{supplier_code} ORDER BY s.supplier_code,m.external_site_name,m.external_site_code
SELECT supplier_site_id,external_site_code,external_site_name,use_yn FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_site WHERE supplier_id=#{supplier_id} AND external_site_code=#{external_site_code}
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_supplier_site SET use_yn=#{use_yn},user_id=#{user_id} WHERE supplier_site_id=#{supplier_site_id}
mapper.select: SELECT ss.supplier_account_site_id,ss.account_id,s.supplier_id,s.supplier_code,s.supplier_name,ss.external_site_code, ss.external_site_name,ss.center_code,ss.mod_at,ss.created_at,ss.user_id FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site ss JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=ss.supplier_id WHERE ss.active_yn='Y' ORDER BY ss.account_id,s.supplier_code
SELECT supplier_account_site_id,external_site_code,external_site_name,active_yn FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND supplier_id=#{supplier_id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site SET active_yn='N',user_id=#{user_id} WHERE supplier_account_site_id=#{supplier_account_site_id} AND active_yn='Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site (account_id,supplier_id,external_site_code,external_site_name,representative_site_code,center_code, price_context_code,provider_attributes,active_yn,last_synced_at,user_id) SELECT #{account_id},m.supplier_id,m.external_site_code,m.external_site_name,m.representative_site_code,m.center_code, m.price_context_code,m.provider_attributes,'Y',NOW(),#{user_id} FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_site m WHERE m.supplier_id=#{supplier_id} AND m.external_site_code=#{external_site_code}
mapper.select: SELECT supplier_account_site_id FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND supplier_id=#{supplier_id} AND external_site_code=#{external_site_code}
